definitions.gloss: uncrowned; without a title or championship
definitions.explanation: Having no title, crown, or championship victory. Most commonly used in sports to describe a talented athlete or team that has never won a major title, often with a nuance of sympathy or frustrated potential.

definitions.gloss: without rank or official position; unofficial
definitions.explanation: Lacking formal recognition, credentials, or official standing, despite having the skill or reputation to warrant them.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) and {冠|かん} (crown, title). The word carries a dramatic, slightly literary quality. In sports journalism, it often appears with a tone of sympathy — describing someone whose talent deserves recognition but who has not yet won a championship.

The set phrase {無冠|むかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帝王|ていおう} (uncrowned king/emperor) is the most well-known usage. It has two distinct applications:
- In sports: a dominant athlete who has never won a major title
- For journalists: a traditional epithet for newspaper reporters, reflecting their power to influence public opinion despite holding no official authority

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無冠|むかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帝王|ていおう}: uncrowned king/emperor
- {無冠|むかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧: player without a title
- {無冠|むかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end without winning a title
- {無冠|むかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to retire without a championship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧: championship victory — what {無冠|むかん} athletes lack
- ⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧: title — the achievement being referred to
- ⟦{無名|むめい}→無名：13420_mumei⟧: unknown, obscure — about fame rather than titles
